speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: The fourteenth Old Kings' cairn (plan M6-M9 decision 33), in the First King's sealed vault behind the Barrow's rockfall (a stage-5 heave, P26): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.valley_vault).

nodes.text: Stones stacked by giant hands, older than the Barrow. On the topmost the First King's mark, and words cut for whoever grew tall enough to move the rock: 'Stand as I stood.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: The First King's cairn. Its strength is already in you.
